title: Happy Glass Draw lines
description: Draw something with lines so that the glass fills with water. Your task is to draw a line so that the glass fills up and youll smile again! Try to find the best solution to get to the next level. You can find your own way, so be creative and dont be afraid to think outside the box! Some levels may seem simple. Features: + Extremely smooth napkin control. + Different characters with lots of items in the store system. + Simple rules and easy controls + Beautiful graphics. + Unique challenging levels. + Game for boys and girls.
